summary: Move the app shell's styleguide stylesheet compilation out of its rspack config factory
description:
Background
packages/shell/esm-app-shell/rspack.config.js compiles @openmrs/esm-styleguide/styles with sass, inlines its CSS @imports, rewrites url(~…) font references, content-hashes the result and writes it into .tmp/ — all inside the exported config factory, before it returns the config object. The hashed filename and the font copy patterns are then passed to HtmlWebpackPlugin and CopyRspackPlugin, which is why the work has to happen eagerly.
That has two costs. Constructing a config object performs file I/O and a multi-second Carbon compile, so it is neither pure nor cheap. And anything that only wants to inspect the config pays the full price: src/browser-targets.test.ts reads module.rules and target, so every CI run compiles the styleguide for the tests on top of the real build. That test timed out against vitest's 5s default (CI job 102554114082); raising testTimeout and memoizing the config load worked around it, but the work is still being done.
Requested change
Move the stylesheet compilation, font collection and asset emission into an rspack plugin that runs during the build. The plugin should emit the content-hashed stylesheet and the font files, and inject the link tag through HtmlWebpackPlugin's hooks, so that calling the config factory only assembles a config object.
Acceptance criteria
Calling the exported config factory performs no sass compilation and writes no files; .tmp/ is no longer created as a side effect.

A production build still emits a content-hashed openmrs.<hash>.css, the same font files under dist/fonts/, and an index.html referencing that stylesheet.

The stylesheet's content hash still changes when the styleguide's styles change, so cache busting is preserved.

Development builds still serve the stylesheet.

Automated tests cover the factory being side-effect free (no sass, no writes), the stylesheet and fonts appearing in a real build's output, and the hash changing with content — the last guarding the cache-busting regression. src/browser-targets.test.ts should no longer need its config-load memoization.
